title: An Armadillo Holds Its Breath 6 Minutes and Walks Underwater

scenes.text: An armadillo can walk across a river bottom underwater.
It holds its breath for up to six minutes.
Its heavy armor pulls it straight down, so it just walks.
Or it gulps air to float and swims across instead.
It picks whichever works for the stream in front of it.
A tank that swims or walks underwater. Watch it walk again.

description:
Armadillos can hold their breath for up to six minutes and walk across the bottom of a stream.
Or they gulp air to float and swim instead.
Would you cross a river by walking under it?
first_comment: Which animal would you most like to see cross a river?
